layoutType.description: Layout type to apply (alternative to name)

data.description: Template data: keys are placeholder names, values are replacement values

styleId.description: Table style GUID to assign. Defaults to the presentation's current default table style when omitted.

kind.description: Overlay shape kind: "sp" (text/preset shape, default) or "cxnSp" (connector).

anchor.description: Anchor kind: "rel" (default, resizes with the chart; needs `to`) or "abs" (fixed EMU size; needs `ext`).

from.description: Top-left corner as chart-relative fractions (0-1 each).

to.description: Bottom-right corner as chart-relative fractions; rel anchors only.

ext.description: Width/height in EMU; abs anchors only.

text.description: Plain text content, centred in the shape.

ext.description: Width/height in EMU; abs anchors only.

patch.description: Fields to overwrite; anything omitted is left as-is.

outputDir.description: Output directory for markdown and media

chartType.description: Chart type (bar, line, pie, scatter, area, doughnut, radar, histogram, waterfall, funnel, treemap, sunburst, boxWhisker, regionMap). "pareto" is also accepted: it is authored as a histogram chart with an added cumulative-percentage line series.

styleName.description: Display name for the new style

basedOnStyleId.description: Deep-clone every section from this existing style GUID as the starting point

setAsDefault.description: Repoint ppt/tableStyles.xml's default style at the new one

force.description: Delete even though a table on this deck still references the style

pretty.description: Pretty-print the JSON document with 2-space indentation (default true)

slideIndices.description: Specific slides to export (all if omitted)

remove.description: Remove the per-point label override entirely

text.description: Custom label text override; '' clears it

spPr.description: This label's own fill/line formatting; null removes it

txPr.description: This label's own font; null removes it

fillColor.description: Fill colour (hex) for this point only

strokeColor.description: Outline colour (hex) for this point only

strokeDashStyle.description: Outline dash style, e.g. solid, dash, dashDot, sysDot

explosion.description: Pie/doughnut slice pull-out distance 0-100; null clears it

marker.description: Per-point marker override (line/scatter/bubble); null clears it

errorBars.description: Series error bars; null removes them

elementIds.description: At least 2 element IDs to group

json.description: The pptx-viewer-json document text to import (replaces the deck content)

showId.description: Custom show id from list (for rename, setSlides, addSlides, removeSlides, moveSlide, copy, delete)

name.description: Show name (for create, rename, optionally copy)

slideIndices.description: 0-based slide indices in show order (for create, setSlides, addSlides)

positions.description: 0-based positions within the show list to remove (for removeSlides)

index.description: Position within the show to insert at; default the end (for addSlides)

targetSlideIndex.description: Target slide index for internal links

fileData.description: New payload as a base64 data URL (e.g. "data:application/pdf;base64,...")

fileName.description: Optional new file name (also updates the resolved MIME type)

deckSlideIndex.description: Zero-based slide index within the nested deck

deckElementId.description: ID of the text-bearing shape to edit within the nested slide, from ole_get_content's deckSlides[n].elements[i].elementId

title.description: New text for the chosen shape

name.description: New Object Name (p:oleObj/@name); blank/whitespace clears it

row.description: Zero-based row index on the first worksheet

col.description: Zero-based column index on the first worksheet

name.description: New element name (empty string clears the name)

newOrder.description: New slide order as array of indexes

svgPath.description: Custom SVG path data (mutually exclusive with shapeType)

pathWidth.description: Width of SVG path coordinate space

pathHeight.description: Height of SVG path coordinate space

overrides.description: Theme colour role remap (bg1/tx1/bg2/tx2/accent1-6/hlink/folHlink -> role), e.g. { "accent1": "accent2" }; null removes the override

style.description: Line colour/width/dash; {} shows the line with defaults, null removes it

locked.description: Whether the element should be locked

section.description: Which of the 13 CT_TableStyle parts to patch

schemeColor.description: Theme colour key (e.g. "accent1"), or "" for a non-scheme fill
